---
title: "Why the US CBO is the Wrong Model for Australia"
date: "2010-09-21"
categories: ["Economics", "Fiscal Policy"]
---

Robert Carling and I have an [op-ed](http://www.cis.org.au/media-information/opinion-pieces/article/2186-fiscal-authority-the-way-to-go "op-ed") in today’s Australian arguing that a parliamentary budget office modelled on the US Congressional Budget Office is the wrong model for reforming Australia’s fiscal policy framework.

I will be discussing these issues as part of a panel at this year’s [Australian Conference of Economists](http://www.ace10.org.au/Program.aspx "Australian Conference of Economists") on the topic of ‘Monetary-Fiscal Interactions: How to Improve Policy Outcomes.’ Other panellists include Don Brash (ex-RBNZ), Jacopo Cimadomo (ECB), Carl Wash (UCSC) and Jan Libich (La Trobe).
